subject: Re: Scheduling Redwood demo — possible travel conflict

Date: 2025-09-02T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood demo — options for next week

Hi Oliver,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited to show how Redwood can reduce per-token cost for your field analytics pipelines. Would next Wednesday, Sep 10 at 11:00 AM PT work for a 45-minute demo?

If that conflicts I can also offer Tue Sep 9 10:00 AM PT or Tue Sep 9 3:00 PM PT. I've attached the high-level deck we’ll walk through so you can share with the team.

Agenda (45m):
- 5m intro + goals
- 20m live product walkthrough (generation, streaming, routing)
- 10m SLOs / pricing patterns for heavy embedding workloads
- 10m Q&A / next steps

Attachment: demo-deck.pdf (pdf)

If you prefer, we can pin a tentative invite and adjust — what’s easiest for you given travel?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

--
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the deck. Quick heads-up: I’ll be out of the office for customer site visits and an industry field event the week of Sep 8–12 (traveling Sep 9–11). Unfortunately that means Sep 10 won’t work for me.

I can do an earlier slot on Mon Sep 8 (morning PT) if that’s possible, otherwise the week after (Sep 15–19) is wide open.

Apologies for the shuffle — we’ve got a product showcase the 10th and I’ll be onsite with customers. If it helps, Grace (copied) is coordinating our event schedule and can confirm my availability from her side.

Best,

Got it — thanks for the heads-up, Oliver.

I can move the session to either:
- Mon Sep 8, 9:00 AM PT (30–45m) OR
- Mon Sep 15, 2:00 PM PT (45m)
